name: capitol-grounds-kit
summary:
plan.md is written; I checked the block ids with `mcd blocks --check`, but nothing is built or rendered yet. West to east along the open axis (z 58..64): a dark Reflecting Pool (x 20..55) in straight grey coping, then Grant's white platform with a black horseman, lions and end groups.
Next come two green lawns on the mapped heights, cut by a pale central walk and the curving north and south walks. Clumps of dark oaks stand outside the view corridor z 44..80.
Last, a floodlit two-tier white marble terrace (tops y 9 and y 11, x 159..182) with balustrades, urns, fountains and double staircases. It should read by silhouette and colour: dark water, a black horseman on white marble, green ovals, a glowing white terrace. Landscape-only kit: Reflecting Pool, Union Square with the Grant Memorial (white platform, black bronzes), two lawns split by an open central walk with curving Olmsted walks, tree groves, and a two-tier floodlit marble terrace with stairs and fountains. The map's heights are rebuilt column by column. The corridor z44..80 is kept open. (6 of 7 parts finished)
